Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] --body <body> --expected-version <expected-version> [TARGET] [ACTION]

Arguments:
  [TARGET]  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>                          [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>                        [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>                      [possible values: json]
      --quiet                                
      --stdin                                
      --actor <actor>                        
      --declared-by <declared-by>            
      --body <body>                          
      --role <role>                          
      --expected-version <expected-version>  
  -h, --help                                 Print help
